title: Gaming's Forgotten Preservation: Piracy?

scenes.text: Is piracy the key to preserving classic games?
The Video Game History Foundation claims piracy helps save forgotten titles.
Many classic games are lost due to outdated formats and lack of support from publishers.
Is it ethical to pirate for preservation? A debate within gaming circles.
